verdict.rationale: The project documents its own authoring path. `skills init [name]` creates a SKILL.md template, and the agentskills.io spec defines the required YAML frontmatter, optional fields and bundled resources. `skills-ref validate` checks a skill against that spec, and a `skill-creator` meta-skill can be installed from the official repo. Distribution works by installing from git repos, URLs or local paths, and the CLI runs non-interactively when driven by an agent. Missing for 10: documentation of what the skill-creator meta-skill actually does, an explicit packaging/publish step or command, and hands-on corroboration of an agent authoring a skill end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill

citations.quote: `skills init [name]` | Create a new SKILL.md template
The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design --skill skill-creator
Skills can also bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources.
`skills add <pkg>` | Install skills from git repos, URLs, or local paths
